questions.question:
In the given sentence, identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.

Airlines have increased fares because according to the new rules only limiting passengers are allowed.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'the new rules only limiting'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. 
 
• Here, 'the new rules only limited' should be used instead of 'the new rules only limiting'.
 
• The word **'limited'** means 'small or controlled in number, amount, etc.'.
 
• If something is limited it is not very great in amount, range, or degree. 
 
 
• *Example: Book early because there are only a **limited** number of seats available.*
 
 
 
• Whereas, the word 'limiting' means 'putting limits on what can happen or is possible'.
 
 
• *Example: Lack of cash is a **limiting** factor.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 ​

**Correct Sentence:__** *Airlines have increased fares because according to **the new rules only limited** passengers are allowed.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहां **'the new rules only limiting' **के स्थान पर 'the new rules only limited' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• 'limited' शब्द का अर्थ है 'संख्या, राशि, आदि में छोटा या नियंत्रित'।
 
• अगर कुछ सीमित है तो वह मात्रा, सीमा या डिग्री में बहुत अधिक नहीं है।
 
 
• *Example: Book early because there are only a **limited** number of seats available.*
 
 
 
• जबकि, 'Limiting' शब्द का अर्थ है 'क्या हो सकता है या क्या संभव है, इस पर सीमाएं लगाना'।
 
 
• *Example: Lack of cash is a **limiting** factor.*
 
 
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है।

questions.question:
Examine the four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. We found both to be very quiet and subdued.

B. Later when we became good friends, they told us about their tragic loss.

C. The Mehras were newcomers to the neighbourhood.

D. My wife and I called on them to ask if they needed any help.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**CDAB**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Sentence Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Sentence C in the given question is the starting of an incident. It talks about 'the Mehras'. 
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because the author and his wife asked them for any help as 'the Mehras' were the newcomers.
 
• Sentence A will be the next sentence because after talking to 'the Mehras' the author found that they were very quiet in nature.
 
• Lastly, Sentence D will be used.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• C: The Mehras were newcomers to the neighbourhood.
 
• D: My wife and I called on them to ask if they needed any help.
 
• A: We found both to be very quiet and subdued.
 
• D: Later when we became good friends, they told us about their tragic loss.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct Sequence:__ *The Mehras were newcomers to the neighbourhood. My wife and I called on them to ask if they needed any help. We found both to be very quiet and subdued. Later when we became good friends, they told us about their tragic loss.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The disaster management team rescued the flood victims.

options.text: The flood victims are being rescued by the disaster management team.
The flood victims have been rescued by the disaster management team.
The flood victims were rescued by the disaster management team.
The flood victims are rescued by the disaster management team.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The flood victims were rescued by the disaster management team.'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is **'The disaster management team****'.**​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'the flood victims'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'rescued' will be changed into 'were rescued'. 
 
• Lastly, the 'by' preposition will be added. 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *The flood victims were rescued by the disaster management team.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** 

__
 
• ​दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• उदाहरण:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का **subject** ''The disaster management team'.' है।​
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का **object** ''the flood victims'' है।
 
• Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखा जाएगा।
 
• और 'rescued' को 'were rescued' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• अंत में, 'by' preposition जोड़ा जाएगा।
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

questions.question:
Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

A. Her face had the most extraordinary expression of horror and amusement.

B. My mother looked up in time to see me fall.

C. But I missed and went sprawling across the kitchen floor.

D. My hand reached out to grab the handle of the door that led into the kitchen.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**DCBA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Sentence Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Sentence D in the given question is the starting of an incident. The author is talking about an incident that happened when he was going into the kitchen.
 
• Sentence C will be the next sentence because while he was trying to open the door of the kitchen he couldn't grab the handle properly.
 
• Sentence B will be the next sentence because his mother saw that he was falling.
 
• Lastly, Sentence A will be used.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• D: My hand reached out to grab the handle of the door that led into the kitchen.
 
• C: But I missed and went sprawling across the kitchen floor.
 
• B: My mother looked up in time to see me fall.
 
• A: Her face had the most extraordinary expression of horror and amusement.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct Sequence:__ *My hand reached out to grab the handle of the door that led into the kitchen. But I missed and went sprawling across the kitchen floor. My mother looked up in time to see me fall. Her face had the most extraordinary expression of horror and amusement.*
